peak_days: Saturdays, Sundays, Ekadasi, Pournami, and Auspicious Wedding / Muhurtham Days
peak_seasons: Vaisakha Masam (Kalyanotsavam / April–May), Sravana Masam (Jayanti), Karthika Masam, Margasira/Dhanur Masam, and Magha/Chaitra festival seasons
average_wait_time: 20–30 minutes for Sarva Darshan on regular weekdays (Tuesday–Friday)
peak_wait_time: 1–2 hours or more on weekends; exceeds 2 hours on Muhurtham days; 2–5 hours or more during major festivals
recommended_visiting_hours: Early morning (06:00 AM to 08:00 AM) on regular weekdays offers a calmer and quicker darshan experience.
crowd_management_notes: The temple witnesses massive pilgrim turnout for the sacred Sri Satyanarayana Swamy Vratham and Darshan. To manage crowds, spacious halls accommodate up to 1,500 vrathams simultaneously even at night during festivals. Seegra Darshan (₹200) provides a dedicated queue for reduced waiting times. Air-conditioned Vratham halls and multiple sales counters operate round-the-clock downhill and along the highway.
